District in Samangan, Afghanistan Hazrati Sultan حضرت سلطان District Hazrati Sultan Location in Afghanistan Coordinates: 36°23′24″N 68°11′27″E ﻿ / ﻿ 36.3900°N 68.1908°E ﻿ / 36.3900; 68.1908 Country Afghanistan Province Samangan Time zone + 4.30 Hazrati Sultan District is a district in Samangan Province , Afghanistan . It is also locally known as Azrat Sultan. In 2019 the estimated population was 45,962. [ 1 ] References [ edit ] ^ "Estimated Population of Afghanistan 2019-20" (PDF) .
